bio_md:
# 宋仁宗 · 主要事迹

赵祯为[[n-song-zhen|真宗]]第六子，乾兴元年（1022）以十三岁即位，刘太后垂帘听政至明道二年（1033）崩后始亲政。

仁宗朝四十二年，是北宋文化最盛的时期：范仲淹、欧阳修、包拯、苏轼等一时并起，台谏活跃，直言成风。庆历三年（1043）范仲淹、富弼等条陈十事，推行「庆历新政」，然一年余即因权贵阻挠而罢，改革未竟；庆历四年（1044）与[[xixia-li-yuanhao|西夏元昊]]议和，元昊称臣，宋岁赐银绢茶。

仁宗为人宽仁容谏，宫女减膳、市井谣谚皆能上闻，身后号称「嘉祐之治」；然因循日久，冗官冗费、边备积弱诸弊未革，为王安石变法埋下伏笔。

嘉祐八年（1063）仁宗崩，无嗣，立濮王允让子赵曙为太子，是为[[n-song-ying|英宗]]。

, ascended at thirteen in 1022 under the regency of Empress Liu, who held power until her death in 1033.

His forty-two-year reign was the cultural zenith of Northern Song: Fan Zhongyan, Ouyang Xiu, Bao Zheng, and Su Shi rose together; censors flourished and plain speech became the fashion. In 1043 Fan Zhongyan and Fu Bi proposed the "Qingli Reforms," abandoned within little more than a year under entrenched opposition. In 1044 peace was made with

, who submitted as a vassal in return for annual gifts.

Renzong was famously tolerant and benevolent - it was said that even market songs reached his ears - and his later years are praised as the "Jiayou governance." Yet drift accumulated: redundant officials and soldiers, lavish expense, and weakening borders planted the seeds of Wang Anshi's reforms.
